title: Cut the first ticfac release: install.sh's stable URL answers nothing until main carries it and a v* tag exists
description:
raw.githubusercontent.com/.../main/install.sh is 404 until the epic merges, and there is no v* tag or release, so releases/latest resolves to /releases and install.sh:48-51 aborts. No tick cuts the first tag after the merge, so A6's one-command install is unreachable until someone does it by hand. Also: install.sh:65's trap expands $TMP unquoted.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 2c68d140f136077ab4f12f06d32a3cadcfb9f716d58187e14dae104c6d2e3bd6 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A6. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/2c68d140f136077ab4f12f06d32a3cadcfb9f716d58187e14dae104c6d2e3bd6.json on the run branch.
